manifest.name: answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style
manifest.description: Answer hard questions with a one-page HTML in Shimo Docs style: the model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI handles templates, SVG auto-layout and an STE controlled-writing check.

bundle.text:
# DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle patch for answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style.
#
# package.json points `dsh.bundle.patch` here, so
# `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style`
# registers the skill. The single `insert` row mounts a dedicated
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem provider whose only root is this package's
# bundled `skills/` directory.
#
# `bundledSkillDir` is resolved from the installed npm identity, anchored at the
# DSH profile (the loader's `baseUrl`), and never built by joining a relative
# path onto `baseUrl`, which would resolve against whatever cwd DSH started in.
# test/install.test.js evaluates this exact expression.
- insert:
    - id: answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style-skill
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        providerName: answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style
        includeDefaultRoots: false
        bundledSkillDir: !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/package.json')), 'skills')

readme.text:
English · 简体中文

Answer me with HTML
in Shimo Style

An agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML in Shimo Docs style.
Markdown in. One self-contained page out. No server, no build step.
Demo · Install · Theme · Development
The built-in shimo theme. Run am config set mode dark, or use the page toolbar, for the dark variant.

[Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) already turns a Markdown draft into one clean HTML
page. This fork adds a **project-native Shimo Docs theme** and makes it the default, so every page looks like a document
someone would actually read.

| | Original | This fork |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CLI, drafts, components, videos | ✅ | ✅ unchanged |
| Themes | blueprint · shadcn · paper · 3b1b | + **`shimo`**, built in and default |
| Look | technical board / cards / paper | white square page on `#f7f7f7`, 30px/700 title, 15px/1.7 body |
| Quality | — | `0 errors · 0 warnings`, WCAG AA contrast |

| Feature | What you get |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🎨 **Shimo Docs by default** | White page, thin gray rules, neutral grays and one accessible Shimo blue. |
| 📄 **One file, offline** | The output is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No server, no CDN. |
| 🧩 **Real components** | Tables, code blocks, callouts, flow / sequence / ER diagrams, charts, timelines, trees and math. |
| 🌗 **Light & dark** | Both palettes are token-driven and pass the theme's contrast checks. |
| ⚡ **Fast** | The model writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI does layout and SVG coordinates. |
| 🧪 **Controlled writing** | The STE check flags wordy sentences and overlong paragraphs before the page is written. |
You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step: the CLI is bundled inside the skill.

Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness or another agent:

> Install Answer me with HTML in Shimo Style: read
> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style/main/INSTALL.md and follow it.

```bash
npx skills add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style
```

The installer ([vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)) asks which agents to install into.

```
/plugin marketplace add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style
/plugin install answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style@answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style
```

```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ```
Manual install ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style.git /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style cp -R /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ~/.claude/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ```

Other skill folders: Codex `~/.codex/skills/`, Cursor `~/.cursor/skills/`, OpenCode `~/.config/opencode/skill/`,
DeepSeek Harness `~/.dsh/skills/`.

</details>

Ask a question the way you always do:

```
> Explain the TCP three-way handshake
> Redis or Memcached for our cache?
> Map out how the modules in this repo fit together
```

The agent writes a short Markdown draft and runs the bundled CLI. The page goes to
`~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/` (the same data folder as the original project; install one or the other, because
settings and pages are shared). Open it in a browser.

Change settings with the agent (`config`), or directly:

```bash
am config                      # show settings; theme defaults to shimo
am config set theme auto       # content-based theme choice
am config set theme shimo      # back to the Shimo Docs theme
am config set mode dark        # dark palette

On the page itself, the top-right toolbar switches theme and light/dark mode, opens comments, and copies the reply
Markdown back to the agent.

The theme follows measurements from the Shimo editor (2026-10). Nothing is hand-waved: the tokens below are the same
ones the theme checks and ships.

| Element | Value | Where it shows |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Canvas | `#f7f7f7` | page background |
| Paper | `#ffffff` + `0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.13)` | square page with a quiet shadow |
| Title / body | `30px/700` · `15px/1.7` | document title and prose |
| Ink | `#3a3a3a` · `#6b6b6b` · `#9a9a9a` | text, secondary text, metadata |
| Rules | `#e7e7e7` · `#efefef` | table borders and hairlines |
| Fill | `#f5f5f5` | table headers, code blocks, inline code |
| Accent | `#2b68c2` | links, focus rings, highlights |
| Diagram | `#d5dae1` strokes · `#eaf2fe` highlights | flow, sequence, ER, charts |

The theme source is [`src/themes/shimo.js`](src/themes/shimo.js). A user theme with the same name in `~/.answer-me-with-html/themes/shimo.json` would shadow it; do not install one if you want the built-in version.
Doc template preview

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Q[Question] --> D[Markdown draft]
  D --> C[Bundled am CLI]
  C --> T[shimo theme tokens]

The model never writes HTML, CSS or SVG. It writes the draft; the CLI owns layout, colors, dark mode, diagram
coordinates and the writing checks.

```text
skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/   the skill: SKILL.md, references and the bundled CLI
src/themes/shimo.js                          the Shimo theme source (built into the CLI)
demo/                                        the GitHub Pages demo (index.md → index.html)
.github/workflows/pages.yml                  renders the demo and deploys it to Pages

```bash
npm ci
npm run build     # rebuild skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs
npm test
```

`skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs` is generated. Edit `src/`, then run `npm run build` and
commit both.

Forked from [Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) by QingYunA, MIT.
The Shimo theme, fork branding and default-theme change are by [kanzakivnw](https://github.com/kanzakivnw).
See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE](NOTICE). The Bangers font that a theme can embed is under the
[SIL Open Font License 1.1](skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/licenses/OFL-Bangers.txt).
If this skill makes your answers easier to read, a ⭐ helps other people find it.

English · 简体中文

Answer me with HTML
in Shimo Style

把复杂问题，回答成一页石墨文档风格的 HTML。
模型只写 Markdown 草稿，CLI 负责排版、配色与图示。单文件、离线、无需服务器。

在线演示 · 安装 · 主题 · 开发

内置 shimo 主题。运行 am config set mode dark，或用页面右上角工具条切换深色。

[Answer me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) 已经能把 Markdown 草稿变成干净的 HTML 页面。
这个 fork 新增了一个**项目原生的石墨文档主题**，并把它设为默认，让页面看起来像一份真正会被人读完的文档。

| | 原项目 | 这个 fork |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CLI、草稿、组件、视频 | ✅ | ✅ 原样保留 |
| 主题 | blueprint · shadcn · paper · 3b1b | 新增 **`shimo`**，内置且默认 |
| 观感 | 技术图纸 / 卡片 / 纸张 | `#f7f7f7` 上的白色方角纸张、30px/700 标题、15px/1.7 正文 |
| 质量 | — | `0 errors · 0 warnings`，通过 WCAG AA 对比度 |

| 功能 | 你会得到什么 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🎨 **默认石墨风格** | 白色纸张、细灰线、中性灰，以及一个可访问的石墨蓝。 |
| 📄 **单文件、离线** | 输出是一个内联 CSS / JS 的 HTML 文件，不需要服务器，也不请求 CDN。 |
| 🧩 **真实组件** | 表格、代码块、高亮块、流程图 / 时序图 / ER 图、图表、时间线、树和公式。 |
| 🌗 **明暗双配色** | 两套色板都由 token 驱动，并通过主题的对比度检查。 |
| ⚡ **快** | 模型只写很短的 Markdown 草稿；排版和 SVG 坐标由内置 CLI 完成。 |
| 🧪 **写作检查** | STE 检查会标记冗长句子和过长段落，再生成页面。 |
需要 [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 或更新。不需要 `npm install`：CLI 已经打包在 skill 里。

把下面这句话粘贴给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、DeepSeek Harness 或其他 Agent：

> 安装 Answer me with HTML in Shimo Style：读取
> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style/main/INSTALL.md 并照着做。

```bash
npx skills add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style
```

安装器（[vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)）会询问装到哪些 Agent。

```
/plugin marketplace add kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style
/plugin install answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style@answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style
```

```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style ```
手动安装 ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kanzakivnw/answer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style.git /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style cp -R /tmp/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ~/.claude/skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style ```

其他 Agent 的 skill 目录：Codex `~/.codex/skills/`、Cursor `~/.cursor/skills/`、OpenCode
`~/.config/opencode/skill/`、DeepSeek Harness `~/.dsh/skills/`。

</details>

照常提问：

```
> 讲讲 TCP 三次握手
> Redis 还是 Memcached 做缓存？
> 梳理一下这个仓库的模块关系
```

Agent 会写一份很短的 Markdown 草稿，再调用内置 CLI 生成页面。页面保存在 `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/`
（与原项目共用同一个数据目录；两个 skill 只装一个，因为设置和页面是共享的）。用浏览器打开即可。

在对话里改设置，或直接运行：

```bash
am config                      # 查看设置；theme 默认 shimo
am config set theme auto       # 按内容自动选主题
am config set theme shimo      # 回到石墨文档风格
am config set mode dark        # 深色

页面右上角可以切换主题和明暗、写评论、把回复 Markdown 复制回 Agent。

主题参数来自 2026-10 对石墨编辑器的实测。下面这些 token 就是主题实际检查并发布的同一套值。

| 项目 | 取值 | 出现位置 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 画布 | `#f7f7f7` | 页面背景 |
| 纸张 | `#ffffff` + `0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.13)` | 方角页面与轻阴影 |
| 标题 / 正文 | `30px/700` · `15px/1.7` | 文档标题与正文 |
| 文字 | `#3a3a3a` · `#6b6b6b` · `#9a9a9a` | 正文、次要文字、元信息 |
| 细线 | `#e7e7e7` · `#efefef` | 表格边线与分隔线 |
| 填充 | `#f5f5f5` | 表头、代码块、行内代码 |
| 强调色 | `#2b68c2` | 链接、焦点、高亮 |
| 图示 | `#d5dae1` 描边 · `#eaf2fe` 高亮 | 流程图、时序图、ER 图、图表 |

主题源码在 [`src/themes/shimo.js`](src/themes/shimo.js)。如果用户在 `~/.answer-me-with-html/themes/shimo.json` 放了同名主题， 会覆盖内置版本；想用内置版本就不要放这个文件。
文档模板预览

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Q[问题] --> D[Markdown 草稿]
  D --> C[内置 am CLI]
  C --> T[shimo 主题 token]

模型不写 HTML、CSS 或 SVG。它只写草稿；排版、配色、明暗、图示坐标和写作检查都由 CLI 负责。

```text
skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/   skill：SKILL.md、references 和打包好的 CLI
src/themes/shimo.js                          石墨主题源码（会被打进 CLI）
demo/                                        GitHub Pages 演示（index.md → index.html）
.github/workflows/pages.yml                  渲染 demo 并部署到 Pages

```bash
npm ci
npm run build     # 重建 skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs
npm test
```

`skills/answer-me-with-html-in-shimo-style/scripts/am.mjs` 是生成文件。改 `src/` 后运行 `npm run build`，并把两者一起提交。
